stemMd:
Evaluate the following statement using only the passage, choosing an assessment with a sound justification:

Every visitor handles an original manuscript.

options.label: A
options.textMd: Not deducible: the passage does not settle it.

options.label: B
options.textMd: True: it follows from the passage.

options.label: C
options.textMd: False, because visitors are not allowed to enter the archive at all.

explanationMd: The passage states that no visitor handles original manuscripts and that some visitors exist. Those visitors are counterexamples to the claim that every visitor handles an original manuscript.

distractorRationale.c: This assessment uses a premise that is contradicted by or absent from the passage. A matching classification with an unsound justification is not correct. The universal exclusion directly contradicts this claim, if interpreted as permitted handling; no visitor is allowed such handling.
distractorRationale.b: This requires a deduction the stated conditions do not support. The universal exclusion directly contradicts this claim, if interpreted as permitted handling; no visitor is allowed such handling.
distractorRationale.a: The supplied conditions do settle the claim. The universal exclusion directly contradicts this claim, if interpreted as permitted handling; no visitor is allowed such handling.
